confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on thin, partly dated sources: a 2026 Iquique cappuccino average, Chile-wide menu del dia reports, and an undated expat beer price. Cocktail and wine anchors are inferred from coastal Chilean data and the beer anchor, not directly sourced. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates with no live listing inspection and no accommodation search. The RBA rate came from a search-result summary of the RBA daily exchange-rate page; I did not open the page itself, and a 2026-10-15 overview figure of 0.6955 was also reported. CLP-to-USD conversion assumed roughly 950 CLP per USD.
comparable_city_reasoning: Iquique is a northern Chilean coastal port city. Restaurant and café prices were benchmarked against Chilean national averages, Santiago and Valparaiso menu del dia ranges, and a coastal Vina del Mar cocktail survey, adjusted down for Iquique's lower price level. Accommodation is a holistic estimate from general knowledge of a mid-sized Chilean coastal city.
